description.value: Long Beach Market is a convenience and general store in Tofino operated by The Wayne Procter Group as part of their Vancouver Island General Stores division. In addition to convenience goods, it sells gasoline (regular, mid-grade, premium, and diesel) and propane in both auto and cylinder formats. Situated in one of BC's most popular cycling destinations on the west coast of Vancouver Island, it serves as a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists heading into or out of the Tofino area.

The listing explicitly details available amenities: FReal Machine, slushie, ATM, fuel (Reg, Mid, Prem, Diesel), and auto and cylinder propane — supporting camping fuel as confirmed. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
